blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A meeting of a sub-committee of select House members tasked to review tweaks to the 2027 budget bill was delayed on Thursday, stalling discussions on the proposed amendments to the P7.2-trillion spending plan. The Budget Amendments Review Sub-committee (BARSc) was initially scheduled to meet at 1 p.m. However, the session was pushed back two hours to 3 p.m., according to an updated broadcast schedule on YouTube. Lawmakers were earlier seen huddled in a corner of the room where the meeting will take place before reporters were ushered out. It was unclear what they discussed, as the media were […]...
